record_id.description: Omit for a new judgment. Existing IDs require exact expected_revision and preserve subject, topic, context, facet, kind, report_mode and temporal interval. Direct self-report IDs also preserve the original utterance set; only their spans/interpretation may be revised. New utterances require a new ID; preference/intention corrections use explicit supersedes. Future changes use a new ID plus explicit supersedes.
record_id.title: Record Id

subject_id.description: Supplied stable ID of this claim's subject. Set exactly one non-null subject_id or subject_mention; omit or set the other to null. The evidence author or reported speaker does not fill this field.
subject_id.title: Subject Id

subject_mention.description: Unresolved mention of this claim's subject when no supplied stable ID applies. Set exactly one non-null subject_id or subject_mention; omit or set the other to null.
subject_mention.title: Subject Mention

statement.description: Model interpretation, never certified by exact quotation matching.
statement.title: Statement

valid_from.description: For existing IDs null preserves the current interval; never moves its start.
valid_from.title: Valid From

valid_until.description: For existing IDs null preserves the current interval; never removes an expiry.
valid_until.title: Valid Until

role.description: Role relative to this exact judgment version; mixed is uncertainty, never two votes.
role.title: Role
